scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && npm run build -w @hablahora/chat && npm run build -w @hablahora/console
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/chat/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/console/tsconfig.json
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build && npm run migrate -w @hablahora/db
scripts.db:seed: npm run build && npm run seed -w @hablahora/db && npm run seed:users -w @hablahora/api
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d hablahora
